content:
Ethan: Quick heads-up — Acme EBR scheduled for Tue 10am PT. Need final slide pack + one-pager of exec asks by end of day Monday. Keep it tight (10 slides max).
Maya: Roger. I'll own the run-of-show and slide ordering. Can we split owners by section?
Sofia: I can take onboarding progress + renewal risk slide. Will include enablement attendance and key blockers.
Ravi: I'll handle the 'runtime health' slide — latency, error rate, recent incidents. Need the final 7-day aggregates. Anyone have the Prom query handy?
Ethan: Use the same KPIs we used last quarter. Quick copy: `sum(rate(request_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(requests[5m]))` for error rate. For latency, 95th pct — `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`.
Maya: Nice, thx. I'm drafting the exec asks now — 3 asks max: 1) Approve pilot budget for Dedicated, 2) Fast-track data sharing for onboarding metrics, 3) Exec sponsor for Renewal outreach.
Sofia: Heads-up — Finance hasn't sent a firm renewal forecast for Acme (they only gave a range). We need a committed ARR number for the exec one-pager. @Anna (Finance) can you confirm? :pleading_face:
Anna (Finance): Sorry — working through approvals. I can lock the FYT/ARR by EOD today and post to the tracker. Will that work?
Maya: That works, thanks Anna. Please drop the number in the shared sheet (link coming later).
slides-bot: Reminder: Slide deck template created at /Shared/EBR/Acme/ — owners, please upload by 5pm Mon. :calendar:
Ethan: Let's do a 30min dry-run Mon 4pm PT. RSVP if you need a different slot. We should rehearse who speaks to each ask.
Ravi: RSVP'd. Also adding a short failover checklist for the demo: `- fallback to recorded demo; - limit token budget; - toggle to smaller model`. I'll attach a tiny script to capture demo latency locally.
Maya: Putting owners into a tiny mapping now:
```
Slide 1 - Maya (Intro + agenda)
Slide 2 - Sofia (Onboarding status)
Slide 3 - Sofia (Enablement + adoption metrics)
Slide 4 - Ravi (Runtime health)
Slide 5 - Ethan (Cost/perf summary)
Slide 6 - Ethan (Exec asks)
Slide 7 - Maya (Next steps & risks)
```
Sofia: One more ask — can someone confirm if we can show customer NPS in the slide? Legal asked for approval last time.
Ethan: Legal cleared high-level NPS, but no verbatim quotes. Use the aggregated score only.
Anna (Finance): ARR posted to the tracker (Acme -> FYT committed = $1.2M). Added a quick note on assumptions.
Maya: Perfect. I'll integrate that into the renewal risk slide and the one-pager.
slides-bot: Deck uploaded by owners is now: /Shared/EBR/Acme/Acme_EBR_v3.pptx (auto-check 5pm Mon).
Sofia: I'll upload my rough slides by EOD today so folks can comment overnight.
Ethan: Thanks team. Rehearsal Monday 4pm, final deck 5pm. If anything blocks, call it out here. :thumbsup:
